cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned Excel/MSForms fixture input generated through public Excel/VBIDE automation and driven with public Windows input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, non-public source, or OxForms output comparison.

notes: A TextBox1 edit-then-revert subject, a CheckBox1 dirty-focus-out subject, and a TextBox2 focus-out landing target laid out non-overlapping so a window-bounds + fixture-layout calculation (or computer-use vision) can target each control by point.

CheckBox1 carries Enter/Exit/BeforeUpdate/AfterUpdate/Click/Change/KeyDown/KeyUp handlers so the capture reveals whether a dirty CheckBox fires BeforeUpdate/AfterUpdate before Exit on focus-out (esq.14 question 1); FM20_EVENT_FACTS.md currently treats CheckBox Enter/Exit/BeforeUpdate as unknown for MdcCheckBoxEvents -- absence of a row is observed, not a negative fact.

TextBox1 carries Change/BeforeUpdate/AfterUpdate so the capture reveals whether an edit-then-revert (type then delete back to the value at focus-gain, net change = none) still fires BeforeUpdate/AfterUpdate on focus-out (esq.14 question 2, the OldValue/net-value gate).

No control fonts are declared/applied (a design-time font set hangs the SaveAs dialog); no Default button is needed (no default-button scenario here). No argument is mutated -- this fixture only OBSERVES whether the events fire.
